description.text: The major takes monitoring and control technologies, supported by technologies of communications, computers, optoelectronics, and automatic control. It is designed to train professionals with basic knowledge of intelligent instrumentation, computer monitoring and control systems, measurement and control network, the design and manufacturing of precision instruments, communications and information processing, who are capable of measurement and control technology, and the systems design, manufacturing, technology development, applied research, operations management of instrumentation in the field of the national economic departments. The major conforms to the in-depth development of information technology and needs of the large number of talents for control technology and instrumentation. With information technology as the foundation, it focuses on specialties of instrument detection technology and instrumentation, intelligent instrumentation, and network monitoring and control technologies and instrumentation

duration.text: The Measuring and Monitoring Technology and Instrument at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
